x: The discharge. The robe of light, the Names of generosity, then the Names of the Eternal — the need already asked and set down.

Recited after the Ḥizb. It asks for the robe of light and the hearing and sight that come from Him, takes refuge in the perfect words, calls upon the Names of generosity and of presence in hardship, then upon the Names of the Eternal — including the Syriac and Hebrew forms — and seals with the verse of sufficiency and the Ibrāhīmiyya.
يَا اللهُ ❁ يَا نُورُ ❁ يَا حَقُّ ❁ يَا مُبِينُ ❁
Yā Allāhu · yā Nūru · yā Ḥaqqu · yā Mubīn.
O Allāh · O Light · O Truth · O Manifest.
أَلْبِسْنِي مِنْ نُورِكَ ❁ وَعَلِّمْنِي مِنْ عِلْمِكَ ❁ وَفَهِّمْنِي عِنْدَكَ ❁ وَأَسْمِعْنِي مِنْكَ ❁ وَأَبْصِرْنِي بِكَ ❁ إِنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ ❁
Albisnī min nūrik, wa ʿallimnī min ʿilmik, wa fahhimnī ʿindak, wa asmiʿnī mink, wa abṣirnī bik, innaka ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr.
Clothe me in Your light; teach me out of Your knowledge; give me understanding in Your presence; let me hear from You; let me see by You. You have power over all things.
يَا سَمِيعُ ❁ يَا عَلِيمُ ❁ يَا حَلِيمُ ❁ يَا عَلِيُّ ❁ يَا عَظِيمُ ❁ اسْمَعْ دُعَائِي بِخَصَائِصِ لُطْفِكَ ❁ آمِينَ آمِينَ آمِينَ ❁
Yā Samīʿu · yā ʿAlīmu · yā Ḥalīmu · yā ʿAliyyu · yā ʿAẓīm. Ismaʿ duʿāʾī bi-khaṣāʾiṣi luṭfik. Āmīn, āmīn, āmīn.
O All-Hearing · O All-Knowing · O Forbearing · O Most High · O Immense. Hear my supplication by the particular graces of Your kindness. Āmīn, āmīn, āmīn.
أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللهِ التَّامَّاتِ كُلِّهَا مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ❁ ٢
Aʿūdhu bi-kalimāti’llāhi’t-tāmmāti kullihā min sharri mā khalaq — twice.
I take refuge in the perfect words of Allāh, all of them, from the evil of what He has created.
يَا عَظِيمَ السُّلْطَانِ
يَا قَدِيمَ الْإِحْسَانِ
يَا دَائِمَ النِّعَمِ
يَا بَاسِطَ الرِّزْقِ
يَا وَاسِعَ الْعَطَايَا
يَا دَافِعَ الْبَلَايَا
يَا حَاضِرًا لَيْسَ بِغَائِبٍ
يَا مَوْجُودًا عِنْدَ الشَّدَائِدِ
يَا مُجْمِلَ السِّرِّ
يَا خَفِيَّ اللُّطْفِ
يَا لَطِيفَ الصُّنْعِ
يَا حَلِيمًا لَا يَعْجَلُ
يَا جَوَادًا لَا يَبْخَلُ

Yā ʿAẓīma’s-sulṭān · yā Qadīma’l-iḥsān · yā Dāʾima’n-niʿam · yā Bāsiṭa’r-rizq · yā Wāsiʿa’l-ʿaṭāyā · yā Dāfiʿa’l-balāyā · yā Ḥāḍiran laysa bi-ghāʾib · yā Mawjūdan ʿinda’sh-shadāʾid · yā Mujmila’s-sirr · yā Khafiyya’l-luṭf · yā Laṭīfa’ṣ-ṣunʿ · yā Ḥalīman lā yaʿjal · yā Jawādan lā yabkhal.

O Immense in sovereignty · O Ancient in kindness · O Perpetual in favours · O Spreader of provision · O Vast in gifts · O Repeller of afflictions · O Present who is never absent · O Found in hardships · O Beautifier of the secret · O Hidden in gentleness · O Subtle in making · O Forbearing who does not hasten · O Generous who does not withhold.
اقْضِ حَاجَتِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ ❁
Iqḍi ḥājatī bi-raḥmatika yā arḥama’r-rāḥimīn.
Fulfil my need by Your mercy, O most merciful of the merciful.
اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الْمَخْزُونِ الْمَكْنُونِ ❁ السَّلَامِ الْمُنَزَّلِ ❁ الْقُدُّوسِ الْمُطَهَّرِ الطَّاهِرِ ❁
Allāhumma innī asʾaluka bi’smika’l-makhzūni’l-maknūn, as-salāmi’l-munazzal, al-quddūsi’l-muṭahhari’ṭ-ṭāhir.
O Allāh, I ask You by Your name — the treasured and hidden; the peace sent down; the Holy, the purified, the pure.
يَا دَهْرُ
يَا دَيْهَارُ
يَا دَيْهُورُ
يَا أَزَلُ
يَا أَبَدُ
يَا مَنْ لَمْ يَزَلْ
يَا هُوَ يَا هُوَ
يَا كَانُ
يَا كَيْنَانُ
يَا رُوحُ
Yā Dahru · yā Dayhāru · yā Dayhūru · yā Azalu · yā Abadu · yā man lam yazal · yā Huwa yā Huwa · yā Kānu · yā Kaynānu · yā Rūḥ.

O Aeon · O Dayhār · O Dayhūr · O Beginningless · O Endless · O You who have never ceased · O He, O He · O Kān · O Kaynān · O Spirit. Names in an older register, carried in the transmission as they stand.
يَا مَنْ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ ❁ يَا مَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ❁ يَا كَائِنُ بَعْدَ كُلِّ كَوْنٍ ❁
Yā man lam yalid wa lam yūlad wa lam yakun lahū kufuwan aḥad. Yā man lā ilāha illā huw. Yā Kāʾinu baʿda kulli kawn.
O You who did not beget and were not begotten, and to whom none is equal. O You beside whom there is no god. O You who remain after every existence.
إِهِيًّا شَرَاهِيًّا ❁ أَدُونِي أَصْبَاؤُوتَ ❁
Ihiyyan sharāhiyyā · Adūnī Aṣbāʾūt.
Ehyeh Asher Ehyeh · Adonai Ṣebaʾot — Names carried over from the Hebrew and kept in the Arabic as they were received.
Ehyeh Asher Ehyeh · Adonai Ṣabāʾōt — the Hebrew and Syriac Names, as transmitted
يَا مُجَلِّيَ عَظَائِمِ الْأُمُورِ ❁ سُبْحَانَكَ عَلَى عَفْوِكَ بَعْدَ قُدْرَتِكَ ❁
Yā mujalliya ʿaẓāʾimi’l-umūr. Subḥānaka ʿalā ʿafwika baʿda qudratik.
O You who bring the gravest matters to light. Glory to You for Your pardon after Your power.
﴿ فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَقُلْ حَسْبِىَ ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ ۖ وَهُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ ❁ ﴾ Q 9 : 129
Fa-in tawallaw fa-qul ḥasbiya’llāhu lā ilāha illā huw, ʿalayhi tawakkaltu wa huwa rabbu’l-ʿarshi’l-ʿaẓīm.
If they turn away, say: Allāh suffices me; there is no god but He. On Him I rely, and He is the Lord of the mighty Throne.
﴿ لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِۦ شَىْءٌ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ ❁ ﴾ Q 42 : 11
Laysa ka-mithlihī shayʾ, wa huwa’s-Samīʿu’l-Baṣīr.
There is nothing like Him; and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing.
اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ ❁
Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli Muḥammad, kamā ṣallayta ʿalā Ibrāhīma wa ʿalā āli Ibrāhīm, innaka Ḥamīdun Majīd.
O Allāh, bless Muḥammad and the family of Muḥammad, as You blessed Ibrāhīm and the family of Ibrāhīm. You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.
اَللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ ❁
Allāhumma bārik ʿalā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli Muḥammad, kamā bārakta ʿalā Ibrāhīma wa ʿalā āli Ibrāhīm, innaka Ḥamīdun Majīd.
O Allāh, send blessing upon Muḥammad and the family of Muḥammad, as You sent blessing upon Ibrāhīm and the family of Ibrāhīm. You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.
